from pathlib import Path
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("ragflow_ingest", Path("infra/ragflow/ingest.py"))

sys.modules["ragflow_ingest"] = mod
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
before = subprocess.check_output(["git", "merge-base", "origin/main", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
after = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
actions = mod.build_plan(Path(".").resolve(), "programming-desk", before, after, slug="swcstudiospace/programming-desk", branch="main")
upserts = [item for item in actions if item.kind == "upsert"]
names = sorted(item.document for item in upserts)
print("\n".join(names))
print("upserts", len(upserts))
expected = {"programming-desk__.receipts__bot-05-infrastructure__ragflow-ingest-on-merge.json.txt", "programming-desk__infra__ragflow__README-operators.md"}
if set(names) != expected:
    raise SystemExit(1)
if any(len(item.sha256) != 16 or len(item.commit) != 12 or item.slug != "swcstudiospace/programming-desk" for item in upserts):
    raise SystemExit(1)
'
